channels.name: Email
channels.built: Plain text under 2 KB, personal sender name, one link per likelihood word; a plain reply in the analyst's own thread is parsed instead
channels.reply: tap a word, or reply in plain words

channels.name: WhatsApp
channels.built: Message with the link and a reply template; voice notes accepted and transcribed, then confirmed back in one line
channels.reply: tap the link, reply, or send a voice note

channels.name: Signal
channels.built: Same message as WhatsApp; chosen by experts who prefer it
channels.reply: tap the link, reply, or send a voice note

channels.name: SMS
channels.built: One message with the link and the numeric reply form
channels.reply: reply "4 likely", or tap the link

channels.name: Microsoft Teams
channels.built: Direct message as an adaptive card; only where the agency permits the integration, which is an agreement and not a code change
channels.off_note: FF_TEAMS is off: Teams needs an app registration inside the agency's own tenant, which no hackathon build can have. Falls back to email.

channels.name: Scheduled call
channels.built: An ICS invite to the expert and the analyst; the analyst takes the answer and enters it as relayed, and it counts only once the expert confirms it
channels.reply: speak to the analyst, then confirm by link or reply

channels.name: Phone keypad (IVR)
channels.built: Keypad answers and a missed-call trigger
channels.off_note: FF_IVR is off: it needs a telephony account, and the tariffs have to be verified with a local partner before anyone says the word free. Falls back to SMS.

cadence.send_hour: the expert's own preferred hour in their own time zone
cadence.friday_afternoon: avoided unless the alert is escalating
cadence.reminder_wording: never carries a count of who has answered

charter: What we ask: one question about a risk you already follow, at most once a week. How long: under a minute. What we store: your answer, the time you sent it, and the name and organisation you gave us. Who sees what: you choose per answer whether ACAPS sees your name, your peers see a nickname, or no identity is kept at all. Public pages only ever show group figures. How to stop: reply STOP and we stop, or PAUSE for a month.
transport_note: No message left this machine. Every channel composes the real body and records it in the outbox; `transport: recorded` says so on each one. Replace Reach.deliver with a provider to send for real.
guarantees: One pulse per expert per seven days across every panel. STOP honoured immediately and logged. No message body carries the ACAPS rating, a severity number or a place name finer than the crisis title. A reminder never carries a count of who has answered.
does_not: Send anything. No gateway or mailbox is configured in this build, so every message is composed in full and recorded in the outbox.
